description: This file is a configuration class for a batch job in a Java Spring application, specifically setting up a job to update SMS outbound messages with campaign messages using Spring Batch.

classes.name: UpdateSmsOutboundWithCampaignMessageConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that defines batch job and step beans to handle updating SMS outbound messages with campaign messages.

methods.name: updateSmsOutboundWithCampaignMessageStep
methods.description: Creates a batch step for updating SMS outbound messages with campaign messages, utilizing a tasklet.

methods.name: updateSmsOutboundWithCampaignMessageJob
methods.description: Creates the batch job that includes the above step and assigns a run ID incrementer.

methods.name: updateSmsOutboundWithCampaignMessageTasklet
methods.description: Creates and provides the tasklet responsible for executing the update logic for SMS outbound messages with campaign data.
